function.name: generate_DNA_sequence

The type says preferences: "A" | "T" | "C" | "G"[], which seems ambiguous. It might accept a single letter or an array of letters. We can pass a single letter as a string. So we call generate_DNA_sequence with length=500 and preferences="A" for first, etc.

We need to produce four calls. The tool returns any. We need to output the calls. The user didn't ask for anything else. So we just call the tool four times.
